text:
anya: kicking off a 5% fractional promote of model v3.1-int4 to prod tonight. watchlist = billing, legal-summaries, and short-chat slices. will monitor A/B and fast telemetry. :eyes:
devon: noted. which signals do we want to treat as hard rollback vs soft alert? latency, hallucination, and exact-match?
anya: proposal: hard rollback if any critical eval drops >3% absolute on the watchlist AND user-ctr degrades >2% for 10m. soft alert for smaller deltas.
rahul: can we make the rule more robust to noise? suggest combining metrics: require either (A) two signal failures concurrently, or (B) one strong failure (>5% abs) on a critical eval.
marta: agree on the two-signal approach. add a third guard: recent-prompt-repeat-hallucinations >1.5x baseline for 5m triggers auto-shade (reduce traffic to 0).
anya: love that. we should also ensure fallback model is pinned and cold-start costs accounted for. fallback = v3.0-quant2 (same arch, non-int4).
devon: deploy-bot, can you run the fractional-split: 5% v3.1-int4 / 95% v3.0-quant2 at 22:00 UTC and wire up the alerting hooks?
deploy-bot: scheduled fractional rollout at 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. monitoring targets: ml-watchlist-err, ml-latency-p95, ml-embed-drift. Will post back on completion. :white_check_mark:
rahul: for automated decisions, we should formalize thresholds in config. sample config idea:
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  fractional: 0.05
  watchlist:
    - name: billing-summaries
      critical: true
      metrics:
        exact_match_drop_abs: 0.03
        user_ctr_drop_pct: 0.02
    - name: legal-summaries
      critical: true
      metrics:
        rouge_l_drop_abs: 0.04
  fallback_model: v3.0-quant2
  decision_logic:
    - hard_rollback_if: >1 strong signal OR 2 concurrent signals within 10m
    - soft_alert_if: any metric crosses warning thresholds for 5m
```
marta: small nit: make time windows explicit per metric (e.g., p95 latency 5m window, hallucination 3m sliding). also, add an allowlist for queries where exact-match isn't meaningful.
anya: good call. we'll add allowlist for 'chitchat' and 'poetry' types so we don't trigger on expected variance.
devon: operational concern — auto-fallback should not create a deploy storm. ensure the rollback path toggles traffic at the router level and not trigger model re-deploys.
rahul: implement traffic toggle + annotation in rollout logs so we can audit the cause. also emit event: rollout.auto_fallback with metadata {signal_set, thresholds_hit}.
deploy-bot: implemented event hook and audit tag. will include in the deployment summary.
anya: next steps: rahul to land policy PR with explicit windows and allowlist, devon to add router toggle, marta to prepare the watchlist eval deck for 22:00 check-in. I'll monitor first 30m live and call manual rollback if something weird. :phone:
marta: I'll also capture a random sample of 1k responses from watchlist slices and run diff-qual locally every 15m.
devon: rolling checklist updated in #eng-ml/runbooks. tagging @sre for visibility.
anya: thanks all — let's keep the first run cautious. post any anomalies here and we'll iterate on thresholds. :thumbsup:
